item.title: NeuroShield-ViT: Mechanistic Understandings of Representation Vulnerabilities and Engineering Robust Vision Transformers
Robust Vision Transformers (ViTs) - Understanding and Mitigating Representation Vulnerabilities
item.description: Examined vulnerabilities in Vision Transformers (ViTs), revealing how small input changes affect layer-wise representations. Proposed NeuroShield-ViT to neutralize vulnerable neurons and enhance adversarial robustness. Improved classification accuracy by 54.85% against PGD attacks and 71.6% against IGO attacks on ImageNet1K.

item.title: Inherent Vulnerabilities of Vision Transformers for Medical Image Classification
item.description:
• Explored vulnerabilities in vision transformers, showing that minor changes significantly alter representations.
  • Developed an efficient detection method achieving 73.1% accuracy, enhancing model reliability for medical image classification.
